body: Manish Mohnot (MD & CEO) on 2026-02-05 (Q3FY26 concall transcript): "capex outflow should be in the range of INR 700 crores to INR 750 crores in terms of outflow" Metric: Capex. Evidence: FY26 'nearly INR 900 crores' (+20% vs top of range), two months after this estimate.
